name: St. Michael’s Church Cluj
elevationDatum: Rigid local foundation y=0; real metres +X east, +Y up, +Z south. Two mapped controls fix rotation, baked into the geometry once. No terrain or Mercator stretch.
note: St Michael’s Gothic hall church has a broad steep russet nave roof, lower polygonal eastern apses, tall pointed traceried windows, repeated buttresses and a separate north Neo-Gothic clock tower with an octagonal dark spire and cross. Parish documentation resolves the 76 versus 80 m figures: 76 m is the tower without the cross, 80 m includes it. OSM relation height=25 is treated as a coarse low church-body value, not the tower total. Nave eaves/ridge, chancel roof and belfry/clock-stage splits are photo estimates; published 50×24 m and 20×10 m dimensions refer to interior spaces, whereas the measured OSM exterior envelope includes wall thickness, side apses, buttresses and the north tower. Two mapped controls fix the baked bearing; individual roof ridges, aperture stations, sculptural simplifications and buttress sections are original approximations constrained to that exterior plan. Exterior comparison photos show the same current permanent structure; temporary vegetation, restoration scaffolding and the Matthias monument are excluded. Cityscape: not tested; Full 3D world: not tested.
